# opstracer_team (Data Source)

Look up a team by its exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opstracer_team" "backend" {
  name = "backend"
}

output "backend_members" {
  value = data.opstracer_team.backend.member_user_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name, matched exactly.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Team ID.
- `member_user_ids` (Set of String) User IDs of the team's members. Pending invitations are not included.
